INLET BEACH – Coastal View Luxury Home | Private Heated Pool, Spa & Free 4 Bikes | Sleeps 27

DESCRIPTION
Welcome to Coastal View, your ultimate multi-family beach retreat! This custom-designed luxury home offers 8 spacious bedrooms, 9 ensuite bathrooms, two powder rooms, two living areas, and multiple exterior decks, making it the perfect space for large gatherings. Indulge in the luxury of a custom heated pool and spa, where you can unwind and enjoy the coastal breezes. Ample parking adds to the convenience, ensuring easy access for all. Coastal View now includes 4 free bikes with your rental, perfect for rides to the beach, dining, or exploring 30A's scenic trails. Whether you're lounging by the pool or soaking in the views from the decks, Coastal View promises a truly exceptional stay.

OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS
Relax in the private heated pool and spa or enjoy the panoramic views from one of the many outdoor decks. Beach access is steps away via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover (note: includes stairs and is not handicap accessible).

HOME FEATURES
✔ 8 bedrooms | 10 bathrooms | Sleeps 27
✔ Private heated pool and spa
✔ Stunning Gulf views from multiple decks
✔ Two large living areas perfect for group comfort
✔ Gourmet kitchen with high-end finishes
✔ Ample parking for multiple vehicles
✔ Smart TVs, and WiFi
✔ Elevator for added comfort and convenience
✔ Convenient electric vehicle charging on-site
​​​​​​​✔ Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies)

DINING & ENTERTAINMENT
✔ Close to 30A dining
✔ Nearby boutique shopping, and restaurants
✔ Quiet Inlet Beach neighborhood for added privacy

WHY STAY HERE?
✔ Ideal for large families or group getaways
✔ Luxurious design with ample space
✔ Secluded location near the beach with convenient access to local hotspots
✔ Enjoy a getaway where everyone, including your well-behaved fur baby, feels right at home.

SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS
✔ 7 King bedrooms
✔ Third floor bunk room with three king beds, 1 queen and 4 twin beds

Coastal View is more than just a vacation home. It's a destination where relaxation, luxury, and memories come together for an unforgettable beach escape on 30A. Please note that nearby construction may occur as the neighborhood continues to grow.

Please Note: The neighborhood is growing, and with that comes a bit of construction nearby, including in front of the house. While it's completely out of our control, we always want to be upfront so there are no surprises. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling.

reviews.author: Jamie H.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Our stay was really nice. This house suited our group of 20 perfectly with beds to spare. The 8 king bedrooms were so comfortable and all had a personal bathroom. This is hard to find!The kitchen and living was spacious - great for cooking and hosting. Lots of seating in both areas. The views were pretty good- construction of new houses were going up in front of the balconies but views to the west were beautiful. The pool and hot tub were clean and convenient. This was a great rental property. The communication was very efficient and timely.

responses.response: Hi Sarah! Thank you so much for the wonderful feedback! We're happy to hear the home was a great fit for your friend group and that you enjoyed your stay. We'd love to host you again! -Nicole

reviews.text: This house was perfect for our friend vacation group! The rooms all had a private bathroom which is so nice when you have multi-families staying together. Only minutes from the beach. It would be better if there is direct beach access but again, only a couple of minute walk. The customer service was beyond excellent! When I had a question and/or needing a recommendation, they were very responsive! Would highly recommend this place!
reviews.title: Beyond Beautiful

reviews.author: Brian M.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Outstanding vacation at Coastal View. The house is more incredible in person. Although it was just my wife and I with our 2 dogs, you could house a large family at this home. The elevator was useful when bringing in bags and groceries. The pool - half in sun and half in shade was great. Same with the spa, although it seemed to go on and off on its own. The neighborhood is very quiet and you practically have the entire beach to yourselves. The management company - Stay at 30A - promptly answered all our questions and requests which made for an enjoyable visit. We're very happy we got to experience at 5 star stay in Inlet Beach at Coastal View.
